title: sys_activity: the home activity feed's query answers 500 DATABASE_ERROR on a tenant whose metadata still lists objects of an uninstalled AI-built app (jpph_*)
body:
Filing gate ① (category): a defect reproduced at a public door (staging, `GET /api/v1/data/sys_activity` → 500 `DATABASE_ERROR`).
**Reader who acts:** the `domain:engine` seat; the uninstall half (`service-package`, `metadata*`) and the REST envelope are declared on its claim.
*(These two lines and the Dedupe section were added by the triage seat at this card's `pm:retriage`, 2026-10-16.)*

## Source

Read on 2026-10-16 on the test1016 tenant (os-4e4qa4.objectos.app, staging): the home's 活动动态 shows「发生未知错误」and the console logs

```
GET /api/v1/data/sys_activity?top=20&sort=-timestamp&filter=["object_name","in",["jpph_contact","jpph_customer","jpph_deal","sys_account",…,"sys_user_preference"]] -> 500 [DATABASE_ERROR]
```

The console builds the `object_name in […]` list from `/api/v1/meta/object`; that registry still lists `jpph_contact`, `jpph_customer`, `jpph_deal` — objects of an earlier AI-built app that was removed (the tenant's 我的应用 shows only the later builds). A filter on `object_name` values should not touch those tables; the 500 says the query path does (a per-object predicate that resolves each name to a table and fails on a missing one), or the registry row is half-removed.

## Target

1. Reproduce on a dev instance: create a package with objects, seed activity rows, uninstall the package, open the home; the activity query must answer 200 with the surviving rows.
2. Fix at the cause: `sys_activity` filtering on `object_name` is a plain column predicate that never resolves the names (unknown names match nothing), and package uninstall removes the registry rows it leaves — both if both are wrong. The data API's DATABASE_ERROR envelope carries the driver message in dev so the next reader sees the cause.
3. A test for each.

## File surface

The `sys_activity` object and its query path in `packages/platform-objects` / `packages/objectql`, the package uninstall path in `packages/metadata*` / `packages/services/service-package`, the REST error envelope in `packages/rest`, tests beside.

## Acceptance

1. The reproduction test green; on the test1016 tenant after the fix the activity feed renders (the PM reads it).

## Evidence

Screenshots on the same branch and commit: [ai-tenant-home-activity-500.jpg](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/23ef817aa/docs/design/ai-build-2026-10-16/ai-tenant-home-activity-500.jpg?raw=true).

<sub>Filed by the epic PM session `session_cdb7a717-def7-4e71-9988-f089fbaa18ff` from the 2026-10-16 build of a library-lending app (package `app.hcpl`: 图书 / 读者 / 借阅记录, a status kanban, an overdue view) on the test1016 tenant at https://os-4e4qa4.objectos.app (staging, zh-CN, the maintainer's browser pane at 1010 × 1119), through 用 AI 搭建 → the plan card → 开始搭建 → the Studio copilot → one change → the running app. The maintainer named the repositories, verbatim: 「ai 搭建的功能在 cloud仓库」「部分前端功能代码在 objectui 后端在 onjectstack」, and ruled on the design in chat: 「同意」 to the four points as drawn, then 「是否考虑浮出」/「属性好需要考虑选中每个元素的时候也要显示」, then 「按浮窗版定稿」.</sub>

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectstack, all states: `sys_activity query 500 DATABASE_ERROR object_name in filter uninstalled package objects metadata registry still lists` returned 4 hits, this card included. None is this defect; the nearest are #23473 and #7557 (closed uninstall leftovers).

Dedupe words: sys_activity object_name in 500; uninstalled AI-built app objects still listed; home activity feed unknown error.
